items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Nifty extended gains for a second day as oil prices eased. Indian equities are expected to remain cautiously positive after the Fed rate hike. The RSI improved, indicating better momentum, with resistance at 23,300. Foreign investors sold shares while domestic investors bought them on Thursday. The rupee ended with a small loss against the US dollar.

items.title: Stocks in news: Tata Group, Wipro, BEL, HAL, Petronet LNG and Bharat Forge
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks exhibited a mixed performance on Thursday, September 17, amid ongoing volatility. The Nifty 50 index experienced a modest increase, while the Sensex noted a slight decrease. Corporate developments drew attention to Tata Group firms and Wipro, with Bharat Electronics securing fresh orders and Petronet LNG initiating discussions for a joint venture. Other notable advancements came from HAL and Bharat Forge.

items.title: Sebi to examine discount brokers’ concerns over new UPI MDR
items.description: Sebi is set to investigate the issues raised by discount brokers regarding new UPI charges that will impact large fund transfers starting October fifteenth. Brokers are particularly concerned that these additional costs may heavily burden them, as trades are not insured after the transfers are made. Additionally, the complexity of quarterly settlements could further escalate their expenses.

items.title: Tata stocks rise on listing hopes, Chandra's extension
items.description: Tata Sons has announced the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for the next five years, sparking discussions about future strategic moves, including a possible listing. However, Tata Trusts has deemed this reappointment legally void, signaling potential tensions that may hinder group initiatives and delay unlocking shareholder value. The conflicts between these entities are significant as they impact leadership and strategic direction.

items.title: Market rides out 'expected' US rate hike, Nifty up 0.2%
items.description: Indian stock markets wrapped up the day on a slightly positive note on Thursday, digesting the anticipated hike from the US Federal Reserve. The Nifty index gained traction, while the Sensex slipped marginally. As bond yields eased following the 25-basis-point rise and oil prices corrected, domestic institutions buoyed market performance amidst foreign investor sell-offs. This resilience in broader indices suggests a healthy sentiment among investors despite the volatility.

items.title: India's construction equipment exports to surpass 20,000 units in FY27, driven by global demand
items.description: Indian construction equipment exports are set to surpass twenty thousand units this fiscal year. This growth represents a nineteen percent increase from fiscal year twenty twenty-six projections. Demand is strong from Europe, the United States, and Australia. New emission norms and trade agreements are boosting these international sales. This trend highlights India's growing manufacturing competitiveness on the global stage.

items.title: Gujarat floods trigger thousands of crores in insurance claims, prompting rate hikes for industrial risks
items.description: Gujarat floods have triggered substantial insurance claims, prompting a review of pricing. Insurers are now pushing for more disciplined pricing on large industrial risks. This reassessment follows expected flood-related claims exceeding five thousand crore rupees industry-wide. The Gujarat losses increase the case for location-based catastrophe exposure pricing. Global reinsurers' stance will largely determine the extent of this pricing correction.

items.title: RBI rate hike imminent? Fed's move pressures India to tighten monetary policy amid rising inflation
items.description: Global central banks are tightening monetary policy, prompting calls for India to follow suit. The US Federal Reserve recently increased its interest rates, signaling further tightening ahead. India's retail inflation has reached a 20-month high, strengthening the case for a rate hike. Economists anticipate the Reserve Bank of India will raise its policy rate soon. This move aims to maintain a sufficient yield gap for foreign investments.

items.title: Motilal Oswal sees surging steel prices to offset cost inflation for metal majors. Here are its top stock picks
items.description: Motilal Oswal expects firm steel prices, lean inventories and resilient demand to support a shift toward pricing- and cost-led earnings growth for domestic steelmakers. The brokerage sees stronger realisations ahead and favours companies with cost advantages and raw-material access, naming JSW Steel and Tata Steel as its top picks.

items.title: GPT Infraprojects shares surge 9% after securing Rs 484 crore railway order from RVNL
items.description: GPT Infraprojects shares rallied nearly 9% after the company secured a major railway bridge order from RVNL. The contract strengthened its order book to Rs 4,992 crore, while FY27 order inflows reached Rs 818 crore.

items.title: PNB Housing Finance among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 17, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a notable rise in futures open interest, increasing by more than 5% from the previous session. Higher futures open interest indicates growth in active, unexpired contracts, suggesting that traders are initiating new positions or expanding existing ones.

items.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 23,300 as oil prices cool down. What lies ahead?
items.description: Sensex and Nifty traded higher as crude oil prices eased to around $104 per barrel, while mid- and small-cap indices outperformed. Buying was broad-based outside the IT sector, with analysts identifying opportunities in select large-cap stocks despite elevated global bond yields.

items.title: Yatharth Hospitals shares rally 10% to fresh record high as Advent set to acquire 25% stake; stock up 20% in two days
items.description: Yatharth Hospital shares surged over 10% after Advent International announced a Rs 3,150-crore investment for a 24.9% stake in the hospital chain. The stock hit a fresh record high, extending its two-day gains to 20%.

items.title: 2026’s Best IPO: 325% gain in 7 sessions and now a third consecutive 5% lower circuit. What’s next for investors?
items.description: ESDS Software Solutions has surged 325% in seven sessions after listing at a 76% premium, but the rally is now losing steam as the stock hits a third consecutive 5% lower circuit. With valuations stretched, analysts advise fresh investors to avoid chasing the stock and existing holders to consider partial profit booking.

items.title: AI’s 3 musketeers are hitting the brakes. Why Jefferies’ Chris Wood sees India midcap stocks regaining favour
items.description: India’s domestic economy is showing resilience despite geopolitical and energy risks, with stronger bank credit, corporate lending and earnings growth. Jefferies’ Chris Wood sees a potential reversal in the AI trade as another catalyst for global investors to refocus on India. He also favours mid- and small-caps, while highlighting domestic flows, gold loans and energy risks as key market drivers.

items.title: 3 smallcap mutual funds returned over 23% in 2026. These 5 stocks feature in all their portfolios
items.description: In 2026, three smallcap mutual funds delivered remarkable returns exceeding twenty-three percent. Notably, these outstanding funds uniformly included five key stock picks. Acutaas Chemicals and Anand Rathi Wealth stood out as popular choices, complemented by other names like Sky Gold and Diamonds, Syrma SGS Technology, and TD Power Systems. Such investments underscore a strong belief in industrial advancement and the robustness of domestic capital markets.

items.title: Kore Digital shares crash 10% as Sebi alleges Rs 541 cr revenue misstatement, bars CEO, CFO and MD from capital market
items.description: Kore Digital shares plunged after Sebi barred the company and key executives from the securities market over alleged financial statement manipulation, non-genuine subsidiaries and diversion of preferential issue proceeds.

items.title: Adani Energy Solutions among 4 stocks closing above VWAP
items.description: On September 17, the closing prices of four Nifty500 stocks were more than 1.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: TCS, Tata Chemicals, other Tata stocks tumble up to 8% as Tata Trusts calls Chandrasekaran’s tenure extension illegal
items.description: Tata stocks took a notable hit following the declaration by Tata Trusts that Chandrasekaran's reappointment was illegal. The Reserve Bank of India also denied Tata Sons' plea to maintain private status. With Tata Trusts holding a majority of shares and opposing the IPO, Noel Tata has proposed looking into structural alternatives to appease the regulator. The upcoming Annual General Meeting is now critical for Chandrasekaran's role on the board.

items.title: IndiGo shares rise 2% after India’s largest airline hikes excess baggage and priority service prices
items.description: InterGlobe Aviation, IndiGo’s operator, raised charges for domestic ancillary services, including infant travel, excess baggage and priority check-in and boarding. The revisions increase passenger costs beyond base fares. IndiGo had reported a Rs 238 crore Q1 FY27 loss amid higher fuel expenses, despite strong revenue growth and expanding domestic and international operations.

items.title: BEL shares in focus as PSU receives orders worth Rs 648 crore since late August. What’s ahead after 183% rally in 3 years?
items.description: Bharat Electronics (BEL) secured additional orders worth Rs 648 crore since late August, covering defence technologies including laser-based IR jammers, communication equipment, cybersecurity solutions and AI software. The orders follow significant recent wins and come amid large defence procurement approvals. BEL shares have delivered strong long-term returns but remain under pressure in recent months.

items.title: Six factors, 250 stocks and one model: How JioBlackRock is building portfolios
items.description: JioBlackRock Mutual Fund’s Balanced Advantage Fund uses a rules-based model combining global risk sentiment with four local signals to determine equity allocation. The model then evaluates 250 stocks across six factors, including momentum, value, quality and sentiment. BlackRock’s Aladdin platform weighs alpha, risk and trading costs to build a portfolio of 50-75 stocks.

items.title: JK Cement among 4 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
items.description: On September 17, four stocks in the Nifty500 that gained over 5% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level towards the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: HDFC Life Insurance Company among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On September 17, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, suggesting strengthening momentum in the price of the stock. This can indicate potential upward movement and may be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Warren Buffett is passing the baton: 5 investment mantras the next generation can carry forward
items.description: Warren Buffett has stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman and become chairman emeritus, with Howard Buffett taking the role. Greg Abel remains CEO. Buffett’s six-decade investment philosophy highlights valuation discipline, patience, competence, emotional control and the power of long-term compounding.

items.title: Market wrap:  Adani Ports, Adani Ports SEZ, TCS, Tata Motors PV top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
items.description: Indian equities ended higher on September 18, led by softer crude prices and supportive Asian cues. Nifty gained 0.31%, while Sensex rose marginally. Midcaps and smallcaps advanced over 1%, volatility eased, and Adani Ports topped Nifty gainers with a 4.94% rise.

items.title: Bodal Chemicals among 5 commodities stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 175% in a month
items.description: On Friday, the benchmark Sensex closed 20 points lower at 74,294. Despite the slight weakness in the broader market, six stocks from the BSE Commodities Index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high refers to the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous year and can indicate heightened market activity and investor interest.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Can SIFs become the bridge between mutual funds & alternative investments?
items.description: SIFs are emerging as a new investment category for investors seeking sophisticated strategies within a regulated fund structure. At ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, will discuss whether SIFs can bridge mutual funds and alternative investments, along with their opportunities, risks and portfolio implications.

items.title: Adani stocks soar up to 12% after Jefferies sees up to 53% upside in Adani Energy and others
items.description: Adani group stocks rallied on Friday after Jefferies highlighted growth prospects across energy, ports and power businesses. Adani Total Gas gained over 12%, while Adani Energy Solutions, Adani Green, Adani Power and Adani Ports advanced following positive brokerage commentary and targets.

items.title: CAS chaos continues: Sensex indicative price tumbles nearly 1,000 points in seconds, closes in red but Nifty ends above 23,300
items.description: Indian stock markets showed divergence as Sensex closed lower and Nifty ended higher.  Sharp swings occurred during the closing auction session, impacting both indices significantly.  Broader markets, including smallcap and midcap indices, significantly outperformed the benchmarks.  Several large-cap stocks experienced declines, while others saw substantial gains.  Investor sentiment improved due to easing crude prices and global yields, despite ongoing uncertainties.

items.title: Nestle India shares slip nearly 3% after FSSAI initiates legal action over infant nutrition products
items.description: Nestle India shares fell on Friday after FSSAI initiated three adjudication cases over alleged violations involving infant nutrition products. The regulator flagged promotional claims on NAN Excella Pro Stage 1 and Lactogen Pro 1 and also found a follow-up formula sample non-conforming for biotin content during laboratory testing.

items.title: These large- and mid-cap stocks with ‘Strong Buy’ & ‘Buy’ recos have upside potential of up to 25%, according to analysts
items.description: Talk of tariffs, especially steep ones, makes the market nervous. Which is exactly why the next few trading sessions are critical, and why being in a hurry to take any market-related decision is the one thing to avoid right now. It is better to be cautious, to wait and watch. And let the picture become a little clearer before you act.

items.title: Tata Sons IPO: Why Tata Chemicals may be the biggest beneficiary although Tata Motors, Tata Steel own bigger stake
items.description: Tata Sons’ potential IPO and internal governance dispute are driving volatility across Tata Group stocks, with Tata Chemicals seeing the sharpest moves. Its 2.5% Tata Sons stake is worth about Rs 30,052 crore, exceeding its market capitalization. Investors expect significant value unlocking, while Tata Trusts’ opposition to Chandrasekaran’s reappointment adds uncertainty around the IPO.

items.title: Jefferies hikes Navin Fluorine share price target, forecasts 14% upside. 4 reasons why
items.description: Jefferies has retained its Buy rating on Navin Fluorine International and raised its price target to Rs 9,405, citing growth prospects in CDMO, R32 and the Chemours project. The brokerage expects a 23% EPS CAGR through FY29, while the company’s Q1FY27 profit more than doubled year-on-year to Rs 243 crore.

items.title: 14 stocks held by 100+ MFs in August surged up to 200%; 5 turned multibaggers in CY26
items.description: When a large number of mutual fund schemes invest in the same stock, it often indicates strong institutional interest and can boost retail investor confidence. As of August 2026, data show that 289 stocks were held by more than 100 mutual fund schemes, highlighting the extent of mutual fund participation across these companies.An analysis by ETMarkets showed that 95 of these stocks had gained more than 10% since the start of CY26. Among them, 14 stocks delivered gains ranging from 60% to 200% during the first eight-and-a-half months of CY26. The trend suggests that stocks with broad mutual fund participation have shown strong momentum during the period. (Data Source: ACE MF, ACE Equity)

items.title: MCX traders complain of commodity position prices not reflecting on Zerodha, broker blames delay in exchange reports
items.description: Zerodha users reported that average prices for MCX commodity positions, including gold, silver and crude oil, were showing as “NA/0” on the Kite app. Zerodha said the issue was caused by a delay in receiving reports from the exchange and added that it was coordinating with the exchange to resolve the problem promptly.
